info.WELCOME_MESSAGE:
Ticket opened by {user}. (**{username}**, `{userid}`)

__Prefixes__ (start your message with the following symbol)
> `=` Sent anonymously to the user.
> `-` Message ignored, not sent to user.

__Commands__
> </modmail ban:1416319768675356766> Ban a user from using ModMail.
> </modmail check:1416319768675356766> Shows information about the user who opened this ticket.
> </modmail close:1416319768675356766> Close the ModMail optionally with a reason/silently.
> </modmail templates:1416319768675356766> Returns a message template for certain topics.

-# :pushpin: Only messages that receive a :white_check_mark: reaction are shown to the user. Editing/Deleting messages is supported.
-# **__Please refrain from pinging non-staff members, as doing so grants them access to view this channel.__**

templates.CHILD_SAFETY:
Thank you for the report. We've taken appropriate action on our end.
## Recommended Next Steps
- If you believe a minor may be at risk, consider reporting this behavior to your local law enforcement.
- Submit a report to the [**National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) CyberTipline**](<https://report.cybertip.org/>), which helps investigate reports of suspected child exploitation.
- If there is an immediate risk of harm, contact emergency services in your area.
-# Please note that our moderation team can only take action within this community and may not have access to incidents or evidence that occurred outside of the server. For more information about child safety and reporting, please visit the [**Discord Child Safety Policy Explainer**](<https://discord.com/safety/child-safety-policy-explainer/>).
